shipBlockers.message: County-neutral runtime contract is not passing.
Running API TerraFusion DB identity is not proven.
Runtime TerraFusion DB content audit is not passing.
TerraFusion DB product load ledger is not lineage-proven.
Benton active/current parcel count sanity is not proven.
Benton sale qualification lineage is not passing.
Benton runtime pilot closure is not passing.

executionQueue.requiredResolution: Each runtime county must pass identity, active/current semantics, product-load receipt, no fallback, and no PII projection checks.

executionQueue.ownerLane: Claude Code / Sync DB, audited by Codex
executionQueue.requiredResolution: Prove the running API is connected to the intended TerraFusion DB before any row count can support readiness.

executionQueue.ownerLane: Claude Code / Sync DB, audited by Codex
executionQueue.requiredResolution: Prove product runtime tables and row shapes exist inside TerraFusion DB only.

executionQueue.ownerLane: Claude Code / Sync DB, audited by Codex
executionQueue.requiredResolution: Emit/read product-load receipts proving TerraFusion DB table rows were loaded through the approved ingestion path.

executionQueue.ownerLane: Codex after TerraFusion DB content is refreshed
executionQueue.requiredResolution: Prove Benton parcel endpoint counts active/current distinct parcels, not raw historical or duplicate property rows.

executionQueue.ownerLane: Codex after TerraFusion DB sales/qualification tables are refreshed
executionQueue.requiredResolution: Prove Benton sales qualification lineage from TerraFusion DB runtime tables, with no source-system dependency in product runtime.

executionQueue.ownerLane: Codex after all Benton data gates are green
executionQueue.requiredResolution: Prove Benton runtime pilot closure only after DB identity, content, load receipts, parcel sanity, and sale qualification pass.
